title: 21章：香魂袅袅护国出
content_zh:
一声怒喝，如同期盼已久的回应，顿时在人群中得到了广泛的反响，哪怕是老成持重之辈也无动于衷。

    一个家庭，在他们眼前，短短的两日时间，便是已经支零破碎，哪怕是心肠再硬的人，也无法做到无动于衷。

    更何况，大家都是低头不见抬头见的乡邻，今日是老李家，他日真的就不会是他们了吗？他们不知道，所以他们需要一个有力的声音，告诉他们，这一日，永远不会降临到他们的头上，永远不会。

    “拿来！”

    “跟我走！”

    在他们耳中，更像是一种宣言，一种宣告，一个庇护的强有力的声音，这个声音因为血脉为羁绊，足以使得他们安心不已。

    张荼率先走出人群，没有在踏入老李家，没有去看李右最后一眼，而是直接奔着王庄而去，那里，有他不得不去的理由。

    而在他的身后，是一群热血且上头的青年。

    张庄和李庄隔得很近，近到没有走多远便可以看见一条残破不堪的公路，而在公路的另外一边，便是王庄。

    张王二庄仅仅是一路之隔，如今却是阴差阳错的成为不共戴天的仇人。

    遥遥望去，那高耸的牌坊，已经坍塌了一半，可是还有一般仍旧拒绝将的屹立在大地之上，就像是一个垂死挣扎不甘心咽下最后一口气的战士，那牌坊上星星点的血痕，就像是战士的荣耀一般。

    在阳光下猩红且刺目，灼热了张荼的眼睛。

    “你今天，要么打死我，要么我恶心你一辈子！”

    “死了，我去陪右子，活着我就恶心你。”

    “莫不是只有你们恶心我？不许我恶心你们么？”

    嘶哑如同破锣的声音从牌坊上传来，张荼的目光闪过一丝疑惑，这就是你们说的进气多出气少？

    这进出都挺多的啊。

    张寰看着张荼眼中闪过的疑惑，以为是纳闷张琳琳的话语，低声解释道：“弟弟，你不常年在家，你不知道，这张琳琳啊，不是咱当地的闺女儿，是外地的。”

    “小闺女儿那丧良心的舅舅，拿着王家十五万彩礼钱，就把自己的外甥女给买了，结婚的那会儿，张琳琳才十六岁……”

    张寰的语气中充满了无奈和怜惜，可是当事人都选择了不反抗，他们这些外人又如何去说呢？

    不外乎各扫门前雪罢了。

    张荼闻言也是沉默不语，因为扪心自问，哪怕是自己当年知道了此事，也未必会热血上头去打抱不平，世事早已磨平了他的棱角。

    他知道，这个世道，是要看实力的，没有实力，你再善良，不过自己过得潦倒沦为一个笑话罢了。

    “你们把我当做货物一样卖来卖去，有想过我的感受么？”张琳琳仍旧歇斯底里的嘶吼着，怒骂着。

    “你特么赌输了拿我去抵债，没钱了拿我去换钱，你特么当我是什么？”

    “你跟李右比，你配么？”

    “我知道李右也不是什么好东西，但是他最起码知道一个词，那就是尊重，他至少把我当一个人了。”
content_en:
An angry shout, like a long-awaited response, immediately received a wide response from the crowd, and even the mature and prudent people were indifferent.

    A family, in front of them, has been shattered into pieces in just two days. Even the most hard-hearted people cannot remain indifferent.

    What's more, we are all neighbors who look down upon each other. Today it is Lao Li's family, but will it really not be them in the future? They don't know, so they need a strong voice to tell them that this day will never come to them, never.

    "Bring it!"

    "Follow me!"

    In their ears, it was more like a declaration, a declaration, a powerful voice of protection. This voice, bound by blood, was enough to make them feel at ease.

    Zhang Tu took the lead to walk out of the crowd. He did not step into Lao Li's house or take a last look at Li You. Instead, he headed straight for Wangzhuang. There was a reason for him to go there.

    Behind him were a group of passionate and top-notch young people.

    Zhangzhuang and Lizhuang are very close to each other, so close that you can see a dilapidated road without going far, and on the other side of the road is Wangzhuang.

    The two villages of Zhangwang and Wangzhuang are only separated by a road, but now they have become sworn enemies by accident.

    Looking from a distance, the towering archway has collapsed in half, but there are still people who still refuse to stand on the ground, like a dying warrior who is unwilling to take his last breath. The blood stains on the archway are like the glory of the warrior.

    The sun was scarlet and dazzling, burning Zhang Tu's eyes.

    "Today, you can either beat me to death, or I will disgust you for the rest of your life!"

    "If you die, I will accompany Youzi. If you live, I will disgust you."

    "Are you the only ones who disgust me? Am I not allowed to disgust you?"

    A hoarse sound like a broken gong came from the archway, and Zhang Tu's eyes flashed with doubt. Is this what you call more air in and less air out?

    There are quite a lot of entrances and exits.

    Zhang Huan looked at the doubts flashing in Zhang Tu's eyes, thinking he was confused about Zhang Linlin's words, and explained in a low voice: "Brother, you are not at home all the time. You don't know that this Linlin is not our local daughter, but from out of town."

    "My daughter's conscienceless uncle bought his niece with the Wang family's 150,000 yuan as a gift. At the time of the wedding, Zhang Linlin was only sixteen years old..."

    Zhang Huan's tone was full of helplessness and pity, but the parties involved had chosen not to resist, so what could outsiders like them say?

    It’s nothing more than sweeping the snow in front of each other.

    Zhang Tu was silent when he heard this, because he had to ask himself, even if he had known about this back then, he might not have gone out to fight against the injustice. The world had already smoothed his edges.

    He knows that in this world, it depends on strength. Without strength, no matter how kind you are, your life will be reduced to a joke.

    "You are selling me around like a commodity. Have you ever thought about my feelings?" Zhang Linlin was still roaring and cursing hysterically.

    "You used me to pay off your debts when you lost a bet, and used me to exchange money when you ran out of money. Who the hell do you think I am?"

    "Compared with Li You, are you worthy?"

    "I know Li You is not a good person, but at least he knows one word, which is respect. He at least treats me as a human being."
title_en: Chapter 21: The fragrant soul curls up to protect the country
